steps.detail: docker buildx imagetools create pushes each child manifest under the tag before the index; with IMMUTABLE tags the second PUT returned 400. Workaround: opentransit-motis set MUTABLE for the mirror only, then back to IMMUTABLE (both 2026-10-31 ~12:25 UTC). The index digest is preserved; ECR holds the amd64, arm64 and two attestation manifests untagged under it.

notes.apiImage: The 1 October API image (ot-t5-api, sha256:e819f089…) predates rate limiting/OPENTRANSIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES (PR #4) and the integrity-attestation startup path (PR #13), so it is not pushed; the API image is rebuilt from this branch's commit once the generation session's Docker work is done.
notes.taskRole: No task role is created: the drafts and the hosting plan keep the serving task role absent (no AWS credentials in the task at all), and validate_drafts rejects taskRoleArn. Only the execution role exists.
notes.dockerAuth: Windows Credential Manager rejected the ECR token ('The stub received bad data'); h0_bounded_test.py writes the ECR auth to a throwaway DOCKER_CONFIG under the temp directory and deletes it after the push.
notes.apiImageSource: The deployed API image was built from commit b551100, whose services/api equals main 325e4ca (before PR #16 API-PERF wave 1, merged into this branch afterwards). Registered revision 1 set OPENTRANSIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES=10.80.0.0/16 literally and did not set OPENTRANSIT_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED (default on); main's later drafts (merged here) add the explicit RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=1 and a {{VPC_CIDR}} token that h0_bounded_test.py substitutes.
